description: Summary counts for renewed, not renewed, new members, and members missing signup email. Renewed and new are aligned so they partition the current-member count card population.
name: Signup Status Overview

stages.native:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'n8n_base_url' THEN value END), 'http://n8n:5678') AS n8n_base_url
  FROM public.global_settings
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS raw_member_id,
    settings.n8n_base_url,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")) AS member_name,
    lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name"))) AS name_key,
    NULLIF(lower(trim(COALESCE(m."Email address", ''))), '') AS email_key,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), '') AS venue_id,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), '') AS btn,
    m."Email address" AS email_address,
    m."Membership" AS membership,
    p.category,
    p.display_order,
    COALESCE(m."Cost", 0) AS member_cost,
    {{year}}::text AS season_year
  FROM public.raw_members m
  JOIN public.membership_packages p
    ON m."Membership" = p.name
   AND p.season = {{year}}::text
  CROSS JOIN settings
  WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary')
    AND m."Status" = 'Active'
),
prev_rows AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS raw_member_id,
    settings.n8n_base_url,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")) AS member_name,
    lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name"))) AS name_key,
    NULLIF(lower(trim(COALESCE(m."Email address", ''))), '') AS email_key,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), '') AS venue_id,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), '') AS btn,
    m."Email address" AS email_address,
    m."Membership" AS membership,
    p.category,
    p.display_order,
    COALESCE(m."Cost", 0) AS member_cost,
    (({{year}})::int - 1)::text AS season_year
  FROM public.raw_members m
  JOIN public.membership_packages p
    ON m."Membership" = p.name
   AND p.season = (({{year}})::int - 1)::text
  CROSS JOIN settings
  WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary')
    AND m."Status" = 'Active'
),
current_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key))
    COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key) AS dedupe_key,
    raw_member_id,
    n8n_base_url,
    member_name,
    name_key,
    email_key,
    venue_id,
    btn,
    email_address,
    membership,
    category,
    season_year
  FROM current_rows
  ORDER BY COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key), member_cost DESC, raw_member_id DESC, display_order, membership
),
prev_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key))
    COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key) AS dedupe_key,
    raw_member_id,
    n8n_base_url,
    member_name,
    name_key,
    email_key,
    venue_id,
    btn,
    email_address,
    membership,
    category,
    season_year
  FROM prev_rows
  ORDER BY COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key), member_cost DESC, raw_member_id DESC, display_order, membership
),
signup_current_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_key)
    person_key,
    settings.n8n_base_url,
    src.id AS raw_member_id,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', src."First name", src."Last name")) AS member_name,
    src."Membership" AS membership,
    src.category,
    src."Email address" AS email_address,
    src.signup_match_group,
    COALESCE(
      to_date(NULLIF(src."Date joined venue", ''), 'DD/MM/YYYY'),
      to_date(NULLIF(src."Start Date", ''), 'DD/MM/YYYY')
    ) AS effective_date,
    {{year}}::text AS season_year
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF('venue:' || trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), 'venue:'),
        NULLIF('btn:' || trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), 'btn:'),
        'name:' || lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")))
      ) AS person_key,
      m.*, p.category, p.display_order,
      COALESCE(msg.signup_match_group, lower(trim(p.name))) AS signup_match_group
    FROM public.raw_members m
    JOIN public.membership_packages p
      ON m."Membership" = p.name
     AND p.season = {{year}}
    LEFT JOIN public.membership_signup_match_groups msg
      ON msg.season = p.season
     AND msg.package_name = p.name
    WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary', 'Social')
      AND m."Status" = 'Active'
      AND COALESCE(m.is_current, true) = true
  ) src
  CROSS JOIN settings
  ORDER BY person_key, src.display_order, src."Membership"
),
signups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lower(trim(s.member)) AS member_name,
    COALESCE(msg.signup_match_group, lower(trim(s.product))) AS signup_match_group
  FROM public.member_signups s
  LEFT JOIN public.membership_packages p ON s.product = p.name
  LEFT JOIN public.membership_signup_match_groups msg
    ON msg.season = COALESCE(p.season, {{year}})
   AND msg.package_name = s.product
  WHERE s.product LIKE '%' || {{year}} || '%'
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 'Renewed'::text AS "Metric", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Count"
  FROM current_best c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM prev_best p WHERE (
  (c.email_key IS NOT NULL AND p.email_key = c.email_key)
  OR (c.venue_id IS NOT NULL AND p.venue_id = c.venue_id)
  OR (c.btn IS NOT NULL AND p.btn = c.btn)
  OR ((COALESCE(c.email_key, c.venue_id, c.btn) IS NULL OR COALESCE(p.email_key, p.venue_id, p.btn) IS NULL) AND p.name_key = c.name_key)
)
  )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Not Renewed'::text AS "Metric", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Count"
  FROM prev_best p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM current_best c WHERE (
  (p.email_key IS NOT NULL AND c.email_key = p.email_key)
  OR (p.venue_id IS NOT NULL AND c.venue_id = p.venue_id)
  OR (p.btn IS NOT NULL AND c.btn = p.btn)
  OR ((COALESCE(p.email_key, p.venue_id, p.btn) IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.email_key, c.venue_id, c.btn) IS NULL) AND c.name_key = p.name_key)
)
  )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'New'::text AS "Metric", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Count"
  FROM current_best c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM prev_best p WHERE (
  (c.email_key IS NOT NULL AND p.email_key = c.email_key)
  OR (c.venue_id IS NOT NULL AND p.venue_id = c.venue_id)
  OR (c.btn IS NOT NULL AND p.btn = c.btn)
  OR ((COALESCE(c.email_key, c.venue_id, c.btn) IS NULL OR COALESCE(p.email_key, p.venue_id, p.btn) IS NULL) AND p.name_key = c.name_key)
)
  )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Missing Signup Email'::text AS "Metric", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Count"
  FROM signup_current_members c
  LEFT JOIN signups s
    ON lower(trim(c.member_name)) = s.member_name
   AND c.signup_match_group = s.signup_match_group
  WHERE s.member_name IS NULL
    AND c.effective_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      c.effective_date > current_date
      OR c.effective_date::timestamp <= now() - interval '1 hour'
    )
)
SELECT *
FROM status_counts
ORDER BY CASE "Metric"
  WHEN 'Renewed' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Not Renewed' THEN 2
  WHEN 'New' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Missing Signup Email' THEN 4
  ELSE 99
END;
